question: As per Census 2011, which of the following states’ sex ratio is less than 900?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Census is the **collecting, compiling, analyzing and disseminating of demographic, economic and social data** on basis of population.
 
• It is conducted by the Office of the** Registrar General and Census Commissioner, Ministry of Home Affairs**.
 
• Its significance is in providing **administration, planning, demarcation of constituency and policy-making** to the government. 
 
• 1st census was conducted in 1872 by Vicero
